content.text:
**Yes, Acme's customer eligibility supports CR-9204, but Sarah Chen cannot approve it.** It needs approval from Elena Novak (Director of Finance) and concurrence from Michael Torres (VP Sales).

**1. The request.** CR-9204 is for ERP customer C-1001. It would raise the limit from $250,000 to $1,300,000. Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive) requested it on 2026-09-23. It relies on the Acme Group parent guarantee.

Two record issues to check:
- CR-9204 is not in the ERP credit-request extract I have (`credit_requests.csv`). I relied on the record you supplied.
- The same extract shows CR-9201, a separate pending request from Sarah on the same date for the same customer, raising the limit from $250,000 to $400,000. Finance should withdraw or merge one of the two so both are not actioned.

**2. The customer.** These all refer to the same company. The address and DUNS number (04-812-7730) match in every record:
- ERP C-1001, "Acme Mfg. Holdings"
- CRM-2048, "Acme Manufacturing" (Strategic tier)
- The guarantees: "Acme Mfg. Holdings, d/b/a Acme Manufacturing"

Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091) is a different company.

**3. The policy.** Northstar Credit Policy 2026 applies (effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31).

**4. Payment history.** The rule is that no invoice due between 2025-09-23 and 2026-09-23 may be paid, or remain unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date. C-1001 meets it:
- INV-60412 was due 2025-11-28 and paid 2025-11-24, so on time.
- INV-62011 was due 2026-07-25 and paid 2026-07-22, so on time.
- INV-62305 ($720,000) is not due until 2026-10-02, after the request date, so it is outside the window.

**5. The maximum limit.** The policy maximum is $1,350,000, which covers the $1,300,000 requested:

| Component | Amount |
|---|---|
| Strategic-tier base maximum | $750,000 |
| GRT-ACME-2026 (names this customer; in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31) | +$400,000 |
| GRT-ACME-2026-SUP1 (same customer; in force 2026-05-12 to 2027-12-31) | +$200,000 |
| **Maximum** | **$1,350,000** |

**6. The requestor's authority.** The 2026 policy gives Enterprise Account Executives no credit-approval authority.

**7. The required approvers.**
- A limit above $500,000 requires Director of Finance approval: Elena Novak.
- A Strategic account above $500,000 also requires VP Sales concurrence: Michael Torres.
- Neither of them submitted the request, so the rule against approving your own request does not affect them.

**8. Decision:** `APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION`

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9204", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1300000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1350000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Strategic maximum $750,000 + GRT-ACME-2026 $400,000 + GRT-ACME-2026-SUP1 $200,000, both naming Acme Mfg. Holdings and in force on 2026-09-23; no invoice due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 paid or unpaid more than 30 days past due",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance (approval) and VP Sales (concurrence, Strategic account above $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["Request record for CR-9204 as supplied by the requester", "credit_policy_2026.md (CREDIT-POLICY-2026)", "acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026)", "acme_guarantee_supplement_2026.md (GRT-ACME-2026-SUP1)", "crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic)", "customers.csv (C-1001)", "erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit $250,000)", "employees.csv / organization_chart.md", "credit_requests.csv (CR-9201 pending for the same customer and date)"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9204 is not in the credit_requests.csv extract; confirm the ERP record and whether it supersedes CR-9201"]
}
```
